question: Should Nuxia verticillata be recommended for: use as a novel food (dried leaves) in the EU?

records.notes: The European Commission terminated the authorisation procedure for dried leaves of Nuxia verticillata as a novel food without updating the Union list of authorised novel foods.
records.source_title: Commission Implementing Decision terminating the authorisation procedure for Nuxia verticillata dried leaves as a novel food
records.target_indication: use as a novel food (dried leaves) in the EU
records.primary_outcome: use as a novel food (dried leaves) in the EU
